new_findings.key: 2025年基础模型透明度指数fmti第三版发布评估了alibabadeepseekxai等公司发现透明度整体下降平均分从2024年的58分降至2025年的40分训练数据训练算力及部署后使用影响最为不透明
new_findings.text: 2025年基础模型透明度指数（FMTI）第三版发布，评估了Alibaba、DeepSeek、xAI等公司，发现透明度整体下降：平均分从2024年的58分降至2025年的40分，训练数据、训练算力及部署后使用影响最为不透明。
new_findings.evidence: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition... evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this progress has deteriorated: the average score out of 100 fell from 58 in 2024 to 40 in 2025. Companies are most opaque about their training data and training compute as well as the post-deployment usage and impact of their flagship models.

new_findings.text: 针对生产环境LLM Agent的高效持续基准测试研究，利用574次历史运行数据（按时间分为校准期与保留期），探索低成本重复评估方法，提供了真实部署十万月活用户的Agent评测实战经验。
new_findings.evidence: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods...

new_findings.key: 对12篇知名llm-agent基准论文进行试点审计发现同一基准同一模型在不同论文中报告的结果常不一致且论文往往未披露脚手架采样设置子集选择评估器版本等关键复现细节提出开放评分模式以提升基准报告透明度
new_findings.text: 对12篇知名LLM Agent基准论文进行试点审计，发现同一基准、同一模型在不同论文中报告的结果常不一致，且论文往往未披露脚手架、采样设置、子集选择、评估器版本等关键复现细节，提出开放评分模式以提升基准报告透明度。
new_findings.evidence: We read twelve well-known LLM agent benchmark papers and recorded, dimension by dimension, what each paper actually says about how its evaluation was run... two papers will report results on the same benchmark with the same model name and disagree, and you cannot tell why -- the scaffold, the sampling settings, the subset, or the evaluator version.

new_findings.evidence: 论文标题为 "Evaluating LLM-based Agents for Multi-Turn Conversations: A Survey"，arXiv:2503.22458v3，2025-03-28 提交，cs.CL 分类。使用 PRISMA-inspired 框架系统回顾了近 250 个学术来源，确立了该领域的最新进展基础。
